title: A PD4 group without an aspherical manifold model
summary: We construct a finitely presented integral Poincaré duality group of dimension four that has a finite classifying space but is not the fundamental group of any closed aspherical topological four-manifold. This gives a negative answer to Wall's manifold-realization question in dimension four.
family_title: Four-dimensional disk embedding and Wall's conjecture

review.reason: Constructs a four-dimensional Poincaré duality group not realized by an aspherical manifold.
